newsitem.title: COMOROS: Comoros bans second jobs for civil servants.
newsitem.headline: Comoros bans second jobs for civil servants.

text.p: The government in the Comoro Islands has told its civil servants they cannot take a second job and that their wives should not be in business, even though many officials have not been paid for up to nine months.
The government decree, published on Saturday by Minister of Administrative Reform Nidhoim Attoumane, says it aims at restoring order to the country's administration.
Radio Comoros quoted the minister as saying: "It is also unacceptable that the wife is a businesswoman while the husband is in the civil service, and vice versa."
The impoverished Comoros have been hit by a series of strikes over the last three months, with civil servants complaining they have received no pay for up to nine months.
Trade union leaders condemned the new order. One said it appeared to be designed "to bring the civil servants to our knees for having dared to claim our dues."
